'''Imps''' are set to return in [[Doom: The Dark Ages]]. A variant called the [[Imp Stalker]] is set to debut, greatly resembling the classic appearance.

==Description==
The Imp is a common lowborn demon of Hell, thriving as a scavenger that feeds on the remains of the fallen. Its body bristles with jagged spikes, and its leathery hide provides robust protection. Drawing on the hellfire coursing through its veins, the Imp hurls scorching projectiles to strike its prey.
